meta.bootstrap: NLSY79 households (HHID), cluster multiplicities from rng.integers as in nlsy_extensions.t3_estimate; AFQT standardization and R_comp_pop re-estimated in every draw
meta.weights: 1979 SAMPWEIGHT / 100, one observation per person (nlsy_ability.py block C convention); mean round weights as a sensitivity

comparisons.col: B: all teachers vs non-teachers with 16+ years
comparisons.cc: C: teachers with 16+ years vs non-teachers with 16+ years

statistic_keys.spec|group|comparison|stat: spec = a key of `specs` (vintage-sample-definition-rule[-hgc9][-weights]); group = pooled/men/women; comparison = nt/col/cc; stat = mean_t, mean_c (mean latent AFQT of teachers / comparison group, latent SDs from the block-A mean), gap (= mean_t - mean_c, latent SDs), gap_obs (the same in afqt_c units; gap = gap_obs / sqrt(R_comp_pop))
statistic_keys.spec|group|share: weighted share of teachers among the persons of the spec classified as teacher or comparison
statistic_keys.spec|group|col_share_t / col_share_nt: weighted share with 16+ years among teachers / among non-teachers
statistic_keys.share|{acs,all}|{measure}|group: teaching shares over person-rounds at 25-34 (acs = highest grade >= 9 and not armed forces; all = not armed forces); measure emp_k12 = employed K-12 teachers over all person-rounds, any_k12 = K-12 occupation whatever the status, emp_core, emp_k12_c70 (1970 codes), emp_{prek,elem,sec,sped,nec}, emp_rate, col (share with 16+ years), emp_k12_given_emp, k12_given_col, k12_given_noncol
statistic_keys.pshare|rule|group: persons classified as K-12 teachers (employed sample, 1980 codes) over persons observed at 25-34 with highest grade >= 9
